name: @noteece/locale
_note: Finding P3: The project currently has three i18n approaches: (1) this @noteece/locale package with JSON keys, (2) react-i18next in the desktop app, and (3) hardcoded strings in components. Consolidate to a single system: react-i18next consuming @noteece/locale JSON files. All components should use useTranslation() hook with t() calls.
